name_zh: 格劳秀斯/荷兰/国际法/海洋自由/自然法/阿姆斯特丹/法学之父
name_en: Grotius/Netherlands/International Law/Freedom of Seas/Natural Law/Amsterdam/Father of International Law
description_zh: 雨果·格劳秀斯 (1583-1645) 国际法奠基人，《战争与和平法》确立海洋自由原则，自然法理论超越教权构建世俗法理体系，阿姆斯特丹法学家为荷兰东印度公司辩护奠定海洋法基础，流亡巴黎撰写巨著影响至今。
description_en: Hugo Grotius (1583-1645) Father of International Law, De Jure Belli ac Pacis established freedom of seas principle, natural law theory transcending ecclesiastical authority constructing secular legal system, Amsterdam jurist defending VOC laid maritime law foundation, Paris exile writing magnum opus influencing today.
reason_zh: 格劳秀斯代表法学如何通过理性推演超越神权与主权界限，展示了海洋自由原则如何保护弱小国家贸易权利，其自然法体系为现代国际法/人道法/海洋法提供了共同语言基础。
reason_en: Grotius represents how jurisprudence transcends divine right and sovereignty boundaries through rational deduction, demonstrating how freedom of seas protects weak nations trade rights, his natural law system providing common language basis for modern international law/humanitarian law/maritime law.
steps_zh: 研究格劳秀斯早年天才少年/莱顿大学/律师/东印度公司顾问
分析《自由海》海洋自由原则/自由贸易/无主物先占
探讨《战争与和平法》自然法/正义战争/国际法体系
评估流亡巴黎/瑞典/外交/法学巨著/法学之父
总结国际法/海洋自由/自然法/战争法/主权平等五重遗产
steps_en: Study Grotius early prodigy/Leiden University/lawyer/VOC counsel
Analyze Mare Liberum freedom of seas/free trade/res nullius
Explore De Jure Belli ac Pacis natural law/just war/international law system
Evaluate Paris exile/Sweden diplomacy/legal magnum opus/father of intl law
Summarize international law/freedom of seas/natural law/war law/sovereign equality quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握自然法如何构建超越主权的普世法理，理解海洋自由如何保护弱国生存空间，评估格劳秀斯对现代国际法/人道法/海洋法的奠基性贡献。
expected_en: Master how natural law constructs universal jurisprudence transcending sovereignty, grasp freedom of seas protecting weak nations survival space, evaluate Grotius foundational contribution to modern intl law/humanitarian law/maritime law.
case_zh: 1609 自由海；1625 战争与和平法；1645 流亡逝世。国际法/海洋自由/自然法/主权平等范式永存。
case_en: 1609 Mare Liberum; 1625 De Jure Belli ac Pacis; 1645 death in exile. International law/freedom of seas/natural law/sovereign equality paradigm endures.
